messages.subject: For Paul Tomory | Responsible growth, government relations and stakeholder execution
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Wilkinson,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Paul Tomory, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Centerra's operating and development portfolio requires disciplined coordination across communities, regulators, sustainability commitments and project execution. My experience sits directly at that interface, with responsibility for turning external expectations into clear internal ownership and measurable follow-through inside a major mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I coordinate complex matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security, aviation and technical teams, while maintaining senior engagement with ministries, regulators, communities and industry stakeholders. I also support external positioning around a substantial solar and battery-storage program and coordinated a carbon-data evidence pilot using physical operating records.

I would value a senior discussion about where this combination of mining, stakeholder and country-facing execution might support Centerra's responsible-growth, ESG, external-affairs or project-development priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Centerra Gold.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
